subject: Orchard Health roadmap demo — narrow window handshake
messages:
From: Alex Gibson <alex.gibson@orchardhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 13:06:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard roadmap demo — compact window request

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the renewal call last week — Orchard's execs want a tight 45-minute roadmap demo for the expanded module before contract finalization. We have a narrow window next week due to board briefings: Sept 2 between 09:30–11:00 PT or Sept 3 between 13:00–14:00 PT.

Can Redwood accommodate a compact walkthrough that focuses on:
- 15 min exec summary and success metrics from the pilot
- 20 min focused demo of the new inference autoscaling behavior and rollout controls
- 10 min Q&A + next steps (procurement sign-off cadence)

I've attached a one-pager agenda and a small ICS with the two candidate slots. If neither works, please propose two alternatives and we'll escalate timing internally.

Cheers,
Alex Gibson
Sr. Product Manager | Orchard Health
alex.gibson@orchardhealth.com

Attachment: Orchard_Renewal_Agenda.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Subject: Re: Orchard roadmap demo — compact window request

Alex — thanks for the clear scope, this is doable. Quick notes:
- We can compress to 45 minutes; will land the demo on the autoscaling + rollout examples you flagged.
- Need a technical lead from Orchard to join for the KV-cache/quantization questions; who should we expect?
- Marissa will own the run-of-show and logistics; Hannah will cover recording and the follow-up playbook for procurement.

Marissa / Hannah — can you confirm availability for the two Orchard slots Alex proposed? If both scare us for resources, propose Sep 1 15:00–15:45 PT (backup) and Sep 6 10:00–10:45 PT (secondary). Also, I'll prepare a 2-slide exec summary tailored to Orchard's pilot metrics.

Thanks,
